title: Invocation policy metering playbook and arg stability probes
content:
Purpose
This playbook defines a reproducible evaluation and metering regimen for invocation policies (routing + fallback + cost-aware selection) and argument stability for function-calls across multi-step tool workflows. It is intended to be used during model onboarding and for automated regression gates in CI.

Background / motivation
- We observed flaky tool selection under small prompt perturbations in the last onboarding cycle (see PR#786).
- Production incidents where a downstream orchestration expected normalized args but received free-form text have caused user-facing errors and increased customer support load.
- Need a compact, automatable test suite that: (1) measures tool selection accuracy under cost/latency constraints, (2) quantifies argument-parsing stability, and (3) exercises multi-step stateful flows across tools.

High-level goals
1) Metricize: provide a small set of interpretable metrics to track across model versions.
2) Corner-case coverage: include edge case prompts (truncation, ambiguous references, unit mismatches).
3) CI readiness: run fast unit/smoke suites on PRs and nightly extended suites in regression pipeline.
4) Explainability: provide per-case diffs and minimal counterexamples for human review.

Evaluation taxonomy
- Selection accuracy: does the model choose the correct tool given intent and constraints? (binary + confidence)
- Arg fidelity: are the arguments produced syntactically valid and semantically complete? (parseable JSON, typed values present)
- Slot consistency: across multi-step flows, are referents preserved when passed between tools?
- Policy compliance: does the model honor invocation policies (e.g., avoid high-cost model unless explicit override)?
- Robustness to noise: small paraphrases / instruction reordering should not change selection or argument slots.

Prompt sets and datasets
- Master corpus size: ~1,200 cases split into quick-smoke (200), nightly (800), heavy-stress (200).
- Case categories: single-step direct call, single-step ambiguous, multi-step handoff (2-4 steps), fallback-required, cost-constrained selection, arg-shape edge cases, internationalization (dates/currency), truncated context, hallucinated entities.
- Example single-step prompt (ambiguous): "Create a calendar event for the meeting with Alex next Thursday at 3. Add Zoom." (expected: calendar.create event with participant inferred; if multiple Alex, model should ask clarifying Q or use policy to select last-mentioned Alex).
- Example multi-step scenario: user asks to summarize a Slack thread and then create a ticket with the top action items. Expected flow: tool=slack.fetch -> model extracts items -> tool=ticket.create with structured fields. Check referent linking between steps.

Annotation and gold format
- Gold labels are stored as canonical function-invocation records: tool_name, args_json (string), step_id, and expected followup decisions. For Drive doc storage we keep a CSV table in the repo; downstream harness converts to test cases.
- For ease of CI, golden args must be strict JSON strings. Failure modes are tagged (missing_field, wrong_type, extra_noise, cost_violation, selection_false_positive).

Metrics and thresholds (suggested)
- Selection accuracy (smoke): >= 92%
- Selection accuracy (nightly): >= 95%
- Arg parse success (smoke): >= 96% (args produce valid JSON conforming to schema)
- Slot consistency across multi-step flows: >= 94%
- Policy compliance (cost-sensitive scenarios): >= 98% (no illegal high-cost selections)
- Regression triggers: any drop of >1.5% in selection accuracy on nightly suite or any arg parse failures on smoke => automatic block for onboarding.

CI and regression cadence
- PR-level: run quick-smoke 200 cases (unit-duration target < 2m). Fail fast on arg parse catastrophic errors.
- Nightly: run extended 800-case suite, produce per-case diffs, stash failing examples in S3 for triage.
- Weekly: run heavy-stress (200 cases incl. synthetic perturbations and token-limit stress) and measure time-to-first-invocation and policy-compliant fallbacks.
- Integration: GitHub actions workflow calls runner container (serving-runtime/eval-runner) using model artifact from CI build or model registry. Use tags to select hosted vs dedicated inference endpoints.

Failure categorization and triage playbook
- Tier 1 (blocking): arg parse produces invalid JSON or missing required fields in smoke suite. Action: revert PR / hold onboarding. Owner: eng-applied-ml oncall. Create ticket (JIRA: PROJ-412) with minimal counterexample and model version.
- Tier 2 (degraded): selection accuracy drop >1.5% in nightly. Action: run bisect harness across candidate checkpoints, compare top-3 selection confusion matrix, prepare PR with prompting mitigations or remind deploy owners about fallback rules.
- Tier 3 (observability): slot leakage or referent mismatch in corner cases. Action: add targeted unit tests to corpus and mark as expected-fail until fixed.

Observability and artifacts produced
- Per-run report (JSONL): case_id, prompt_snippet, expected_tool, predicted_tool, expected_args, predicted_args, normalized_diff, run_tags.
- Aggregate dashboard: selection accuracy by category, arg-parse pass rate, FIFO latency percentiles, policy-violation counts. Hook dashboards to Console (product-obs) for model owners.
- Saved failing cases bucketed by failure tag for replay.

Example failing case (realistic)
- Prompt: "Schedule send an invoice to L. Wang for last month; include the PO 0872-CC and bill to R&D budget."
- Observed: model dropped numeric PO suffix and put billing address in free-text note rather than structured billing_code field. Failure tags: missing_field, slot_mismatch.
- Action: add slot-specific soft prompts and update canonical args schema to enforce billing_code non-empty.

Perturbation strategy (heavy-stress)
- Fuzz paraphrases: swap active/passive voice, inject parenthetical comments, reorder clauses.
- Truncate / pad context: simulate truncated token windows to stress referent resolution.
- Cost pressure: include guardrail tokens like "use low-cost model unless accuracy-critical" and validate policy path.
- Latency simulation: inject synthetic delay into tool endpoints to force model into fallback choices; assert fallback correctness.

Small-scale pilot results (summary)
- Pilot run on model v1.4-beta against smoke suite (200 cases): selection accuracy 93.5%, arg parse success 98.0%, slot consistency 95.0%. Notable regressions: 7/200 ambiguous-name cases produced wrong participant for calendar.create.
- Action taken: added clarifying followup prompt templates for ambiguous-person cases and a policy that forces explicit-clarify for <0.6 name-confidence.

Automation checklist for onboarding a new model
- [ ] Add model artifact to model-registry with metadata (tokenizer, max_seq, quant profile).
- [ ] Run quick-smoke suite locally.
- [ ] Open onboarding PR with per-metric deltas and per-case failure examples.
- [ ] If smoke passes, schedule nightly run and monitor for 24h.
- [ ] If nightly shows regression, follow triage playbook.

Open questions / TODOs
- How to represent confidence thresholds across different model families (decoder-only vs. mix)? Currently heuristic tuned for LLaMA-family. Need a normalization layer.
- Do we prefer clarifying followups or deterministic fallback selection in enterprise contexts? Policy decision required (security/product).
- Automate generation of paraphrase perturbations via paraphrase LLM and vet for label drift.

Appendix: quick CLI examples
- Run smoke suite: 
  python -m eval_runner.run --suite smoke --model artifact://models/v1.4-beta --out reports/smoke-v1.4-beta.jsonl
- Convert failing examples to triage CSV: 
  python -m eval_runner.reports.extract --input reports/smoke-v1.4-beta.jsonl --filter fail > triage/smoke-fails.csv

Contacts
- On-call applied-ml: eng-applied-ml rotation (see internal calendar), primary owner: Evan Coleman, backups: Asha Patel, Priya Natarajan.

Notes
- This doc is intentionally compact: the canonical prompt corpus and runner live in the repo at experiments/invocation_policy_metering. See linked PR for current harness.

Change log
- 2024-11-03: initial draft and corpus sketch.
- 2024-11-20: added CI gating thresholds and pilot results summary.
- 2024-12-02: clarified failure tiers and added CLI snippets.
